operatingProfile.cpu: RP2350A A4 design intent, normal150MHz, default1.1Vcore, both cores available within load budget; no overclock
operatingProfile.thermalAcceptance: Design junction<=100C and passivebody<=85C; no measured temperatures or candidate thermal resistance.
operatingProfile.resistorToleranceScreen: 2% effective resistor bound covers1% initial plus temperature coefficient/rounding over selected0..50C ambient; not a universal full-temperature tolerance.
operatingProfile.edgeTimeConvention: Design fastest-edge screening assumption, not a guaranteed driver specification. Compare actual waveforms/IBIS before assigning electrical performance; faster edges require updated analysis.
operatingProfile.budgetPhaseScope: PWR1/PWR2 calculations cover established rails and the stated workload modes, not uncontrolled initial capacitor charging. Per-net charging pulses are screened separately and are not assumed simultaneous with every steady maximum. Initial startup/inrush must be compared with rail-current targets before electrical rating; no unverified startup current limit is asserted.
operatingProfile.USBClockCondition: With active USB, application clk_sys must exceed clk_usb by at least10% per RP2350-E12; normal150MHz versus48MHz satisfies this. Preserve application obligation when changing clocks or entering low power.

laterAcceptanceQuestions: Native ERC/DRC and exact source bindings remain required; flags do not qualify power.
USB current entitlement, inrush, suspend and held-BOOT cold startup require integration acceptance; do not claim certified USB hotplug.
Regulation, thermal, core-buck stability, L2 hot rolloff and resistor startup pulse behavior remain candidate/prototype acceptance.
QSPI/SWD/GPIO timing, edge/current envelopes, crystal startup/drive and ADC settling/calibration remain unverified.

externalPowerAssumptions.USB_VBUS: Only when a valid USB source is present at J1.A4 with J1.A1 return. Duplicated contacts stay connected. J3.20 is not another supply or external load in this baseline. Source permission and inrush constraints apply.
externalPowerAssumptions.EXTERNAL_VSYS: Source at J3.19 with J3.18 return may operate with USB absent. With USB present, external reverse blocking or a power-path circuit MUST protect the external source. Declaring two possible inputs does not assert simultaneous source presence or permit unprotected parallel sources.

powerModes.conditions: Before configuration/default current: VBUS<=100mA;3V3 total<=60mA including flash, external header load0, GPIO external loads0 and LEDoff. Firmware/workload must respect this.150MHz capability does not guarantee every workload fits. Inrush is separate and unqualified.
Host grants declared consumption up to500mA; normal input target<=400mA continuous and<=500mA for10ms including all board/external loads. No1.5A/3A entitlement from two Rd resistors.
External regulated/current-limited source1.8..5.5V at U2 under load; capability>=0.75A continuous and1A/10ms. USB absent; no VBUS/VSYS header loads beyond board.

External VSYS feed includes external reverse-blocking diode/FET/power path. D1 blocks VSYS-to-VBUS but not USB-to-external-source. Raw cell or unprotected source directly on VSYS with USB is prohibited; this is not a battery charger.
ENlow disables3V3 but VSYS and input capacitor can remain energized. Absent/reverse-biased USB does not supply through D1. No GPIO/QSPI/SWD backpower; disable USB pullup if VBUS absent.

Firmware enters low power and external loads are gated for applicable USB suspend behavior. Conservative project targetVBUS<=500uA; not a claim of the current normative ceiling or demonstrated current. Normal features remain available outside suspend.
